description: This Java class 'DefaultEdgeUpgradeInstructionsService' provides methods for generating upgrade instructions for edge devices, handling different upgrade methods (docker, Linux), and checking upgrade availability based on version comparisons. It manages upgrade info mappings and reads instruction templates from files.

classes.name: DefaultEdgeUpgradeInstructionsService
classes.description: Service class for managing edge upgrade instructions, including version checks and instruction generation for different upgrade methods.

methods.name: getUpgradeInstructions
methods.description: Returns upgrade instructions based on edge version and upgrade method.

methods.name: updateInstructionMap
methods.description: Updates internal map of upgrade version info.

methods.name: isUpgradeAvailable
methods.description: Checks if an upgrade is available for a specific edge device.

methods.name: getDockerUpgradeInstructions
methods.description: Generates upgrade instructions for Docker-based upgrades.

methods.name: getLinuxUpgradeInstructions
methods.description: Generates upgrade instructions for Linux-based upgrades.

methods.name: getBaseDirName
methods.description: Returns the base directory name for upgrade files.

methods.name: isVersionGreaterOrEqualsThan
methods.description: Compares two version strings to determine if the first is greater than or equal to the second.
